canonical_project: Wingu Africa Dar es Salaam Data Centre (Mbezi)
notes: First carrier-neutral Tier III data centre and cable landing station in Tanzania; Phase 1 launched mid-2022 at Mbezi Beach industrial area (Dar es Salaam); Phase 2 expansion (US$50m, groundbreaking Mar 2025 per DCD) takes campus to 3MW; TIX internet exchange extended to the facility; direct access to SEACOM, EASSy and 2Africa at Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar and Tanga; tenants include Vodacom, Tigo, Halotel, Liquid Intelligent Technologies.
